name: iceberg_maintenance
description: Iceberg table maintenance: expire snapshots, remove orphans, compact files

taskParams.rawScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
SPARK_VERSION="${SPARK_VERSION:-4.1}"
if [ "$SPARK_VERSION" = "4.1" ]; then
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master-41"
else
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master"
fi
docker exec $SPARK_CONTAINER /opt/spark/bin/spark-submit --version > /dev/null 2>&1 \
    && echo "Spark cluster available" \
    || (echo "Spark cluster not available" && exit 1)

#!/bin/bash
SPARK_VERSION="${SPARK_VERSION:-4.1}"
if [ "$SPARK_VERSION" = "4.1" ]; then
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master-41"
else
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master"
fi
CUTOFF_DATE=$(date -d '7 days ago' '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
docker exec $SPARK_CONTAINER /opt/spark/bin/spark-sql -e "
    CALL iceberg.system.expire_snapshots(
        table => 'iceberg.bronze.orders',
        older_than => TIMESTAMP '$CUTOFF_DATE',
        retain_last => 5
    )
" 2>/dev/null || echo "Skipping iceberg.bronze.orders - table may not exist"

#!/bin/bash
SPARK_VERSION="${SPARK_VERSION:-4.1}"
if [ "$SPARK_VERSION" = "4.1" ]; then
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master-41"
else
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master"
fi
CUTOFF_DATE=$(date -d '3 days ago' '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
docker exec $SPARK_CONTAINER /opt/spark/bin/spark-sql -e "
    CALL iceberg.system.remove_orphan_files(
        table => 'iceberg.bronze.orders',
        older_than => TIMESTAMP '$CUTOFF_DATE'
    )
" 2>/dev/null || echo "Skipping iceberg.bronze.orders - table may not exist"

#!/bin/bash
SPARK_VERSION="${SPARK_VERSION:-4.1}"
if [ "$SPARK_VERSION" = "4.1" ]; then
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master-41"
else
    SPARK_CONTAINER="spark-master"
fi
docker exec $SPARK_CONTAINER /opt/spark/bin/spark-sql -e "
    CALL iceberg.system.rewrite_data_files(
        table => 'iceberg.bronze.orders',
        options => map(
            'target-file-size-bytes', '134217728',
            'min-input-files', '5'
        )
    )
" 2>/dev/null || echo "Skipping iceberg.bronze.orders - table may not exist or no files to compact"
